data.cultural_impact: The title Rabbiya holds great respect and reverence in Islamic culture, signifying a deep commitment and dedication to serving Allah. Women who bear this title are often seen as pious and devout, taking on important roles in their communities as teachers, supervisors of religious education, or heads of women's organizations.

It emphasizes the importance of submitting oneself to the divine will, and constantly striving towards righteousness, loyalty, and obedience to the Creator.
